claims.text: The hotel is in the heart of downtown Seattle on Pine Street.

findings.quote: Nestled in the heart of downtown Seattle on Pine Street, our luxury hotel offers effortless access to the city's most iconic landmarks
findings.note: The official page states the hotel is in the heart of downtown Seattle on Pine Street.

claims.text: The hotel offers easy access to Pike Place Market and the historic Paramount Theatre.

findings.quote: our luxury hotel offers effortless access to the city's most iconic landmarks, from the timeless charm of Pike Place Market to the historic Paramount Theatre
findings.note: Both landmarks are named as offering effortless access.

claims.text: The hotel is a mile from the Space Needle, reachable on foot or by monorail.

findings.quote: Just a mile from the Space Needle, guests can take a scenic stroll or ride the monorail to explore the city's vibrant energy.
findings.note: Covers the one-mile distance and both the walking and monorail options.

claims.text: The Westlake Center light rail station is 1.5 blocks from the hotel.

findings.quote: SeaTac Airport to Westlake Center (1.5 blocks from Grand Hyatt Seattle) takes 38 minutes.
findings.note: Westlake Center light rail is stated to be 1.5 blocks from the hotel.

findings.quote: Grand Hyatt Seattle is located 1.5 blocks from the Light Rail station.
findings.note: Confirms the 1.5-block distance to the light rail station at Westlake Center.

claims.text: Rooms and suites feature stone entryways, rich wood details and Venetian plaster walls.

findings.quote: our luxury hotel rooms and decadent suites feature stone entryways, rich wood details and Venetian plaster walls that surround you with elegance
findings.note: All three features are listed for rooms and suites.

claims.text: Rooms have remote-controlled floor-to-ceiling blackout curtains.

findings.quote: then open your remote-controlled floor-to-ceiling blackout curtains and behold stunning views of downtown Seattle and Puget Sound
findings.note: Remote-controlled floor-to-ceiling blackout curtains are stated.

claims.text: The Corner Deluxe Fitness Equipped room has its own fitness area with a Peloton bike, free weights and a yoga mat.

findings.quote: A fitness area includes a Peloton bike, free weights and a yoga mat.
findings.note: This appears in the 1 King Bed Corner Deluxe Fitness Equipped room description.

claims.text: The Grand Club Lounge serves a daily hot breakfast plus refreshments and snacks all day.

findings.quote: Enjoy a daily hot breakfast and an array of refreshments and snacks all day.
findings.note: This appears in the Grand Club Lounge description.

claims.text: The fitness center has Peloton bikes, strength training equipment and free weights.

findings.quote: Hop on a Peloton bike or get pumped on advanced strength training equipment and free weights.
findings.note: This appears in the Fitness Center description.

claims.text: The Elliott Bar is a Champagne bar serving Champagne cocktails and premium Champagnes and spirits.

findings.quote: Welcome to The Elliott Bar, a must-visit Champagne bar in downtown Seattle.
findings.note: Identifies the Elliott Bar as a Champagne bar.

findings.quote: our expertly crafted Champagne cocktails and curated selection of premium Champagnes and spirits set the stage for an unforgettable evening
findings.note: Covers the Champagne cocktails, premium Champagnes and spirits.

claims.text: Qiao Lin Hotpot, off the lobby, offers Chongqing hotpot.

findings.quote: Located off the Grand Hyatt Seattle lobby, Qiao Lin Hotpot offers an authentic Chongqing Hotpot experience
findings.note: Confirms both the location off the lobby and the Chongqing hotpot.

claims.text: Dogs are welcome, and housekeeping delivers a dog bed and water bowls.

findings.quote: We are delighted to welcome your canine companions at our pet-friendly downtown Seattle hotel!
findings.note: Dogs are welcome.

findings.quote: Our housekeeping staff will deliver a dog bed and water bowls.
findings.note: Housekeeping delivers a dog bed and water bowls.

claims.text: Bay View rooms are on or above the 22nd floor and look out over Elliott Bay.

findings.quote: Delight in sweeping views of Elliott Bay from a lofty hotel room on or above our 22nd floor.
findings.note: This appears in the 1 King Bed Bay View description.

claims.text: Bathrooms have Carrara marble accents and deep soaking tubs.

findings.quote: Get ready in bathrooms with Carrera marble accents and deep soaking tubs
findings.note: The page spells it 'Carrera'; it refers to the same marble accents and deep soaking tubs.

findings.quote: deep-soaking hot tubs in Carrara marble bathrooms
findings.note: Corroborates Carrara marble bathrooms with deep soaking tubs.

claims.text: Club Access rooms include entry to the Grand Club Lounge on the 27th floor.

findings.quote: Elevate your stay by opting for a Club Access room, granting you entry to our secluded lounge on the 27th floor.
findings.note: Club Access rooms grant entry to the 27th-floor lounge.

findings.quote: enjoy access to our 27th-floor Grand Club Lounge, including daily breakfast & more
findings.note: Names the lounge as the Grand Club Lounge on the 27th floor.

claims.text: The fitness center has a steam room, sauna and jetted tub.

findings.quote: Purify your body and mind in the steam room, sauna or jetted tub, all accessible daily from 6 a.m.–midnight.
findings.note: This appears in the Fitness Center description.

claims.text: Rooms and suites have views of downtown Seattle and Elliott Bay.

findings.quote: unwind in elegantly appointed rooms and suites, where sweeping views of downtown Seattle and Elliott Bay set the scene for relaxation
findings.note: Rooms and suites have views of downtown Seattle and Elliott Bay.

claims.text: The Elaia Spa is not in the hotel itself; it is across the street at Hyatt at Olive 8.

findings.quote: The eco-friendly Elaia Spa, located across the street at “Hyatt at Olive8,”
findings.note: The spa is located across the street at Hyatt at Olive 8, not in the hotel itself.

claims.text: The hotel is cash-free and does not accept cash as payment.

findings.quote: Grand Hyatt Seattle is a cash-free environment and is no longer exchanging or accepting cash as a payment.
findings.note: The hotel is cash-free and does not accept cash.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes a busy urban setting with typical city noise levels.
